frequency_question: What proportion of major financial service tax notification proposals successfully complete all mandatory administrative, consultative, and formal enactment steps within a 90-day window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal proposals submitted to the apex tax council regarding financial sector tax adjustments that reached final notification stage; excludes informal discussions that never progressed to formal agenda items.

cases.name: Initial GST rate rationalization for financial intermediaries (2017)
Exemption removal on specific banking services (2019)
GST clarification on digital payment intermediaries (2021)
Rate revision on co-lending guarantee fees (2023)

coverage_note: 4 major financial tax notification cycles evaluated; representative of standard administrative throughput capacity.
known_gaps: Does not account for unexpected administrative bottlenecks outside standard procedural timelines.
skeleton: Decomposed into standard council cycle stages: Agenda Framing (15 days) + Stakeholder Consultation (30 days) + Committee Review (15 days) + Council Meeting & Final Notification (15 days), totaling 75 baseline business-to-calendar days under full cooperation.
multiplier: 4 historical benchmark cycles evaluated for procedural duration.
validity_reason: Procedural rules and committee meeting frequencies for the council remain stable over multi-year periods barring legislative overhauls.
